title: Kyoto Takao Three Temples
subtitle: 1-Day Autumn Leaves Route
description: A focused one-day Kyoto itinerary through three of Takao's most beautiful temples — known by locals as the secret maple-leaf valley. Perfect for autumn travelers who want to escape the Kyoto crowds.
features: 8-page PDF: 3-temple route with timing for peak autumn colors
